scripts.setup: bun install && bun run build && bun run pods
scripts.codegen: bun run build && bun run --cwd packages/react-native-nitro-image-compressor specs
scripts.clean:all: cd example/android && (./gradlew clean 2>/dev/null || true) && cd ../.. && bun run clean && rm -rf node_modules example/node_modules packages/*/node_modules example/ios/Pods example/ios/Podfile.lock example/android/.gradle example/android/app/.cxx
scripts.example:ios: bun run build && bun --cwd example ios
scripts.example:android: bun run build && bun --cwd example android
scripts.example:clean: bun run clean && bun run example:pods
